title_en: Spring 2027 Graduate Admission: Information for Admitted Applicants
summary: Applicants admitted in the 2027 graduate school first-round (spring) admission must pay tuition between 1 February 2027, 10:00, and 5 February 2027, 16:00, using the tuition invoice printed from the admission website. They must also submit the required original documents by 11 February 2027 to the academic administration office of the college or graduate school to which their program belongs (applicants to the College of Natural Sciences and the College of Engineering submit to their department office). Admission is cancelled if documents are not submitted on time without a special reason.
applies_to: All applicants admitted in the 2027 academic year graduate school first-round (spring) admission (전기모집). This includes master's, integrated master's-doctoral and doctoral program admits. Registration (tuition payment) and document submission are mandatory. The degree certificate requirements depend on the program admitted to. The additional documents (such as a certificate of entry and exit or a medical certificate) apply only to applicants who were admitted after taking a video interview. Extra verification requirements apply to graduates of foreign universities.

dates.what: Registration period (tuition payment) for all admitted applicants
Tuition invoice can be printed from the admission results screen
Certificate of admission can be printed
dates.when: Only during the announcement and registration periods; it is not reissued afterwards

dates.what: Deadline for submitting required documents for all admitted applicants

conditions: Admission will be cancelled if the required documents are not submitted by the deadline without a special reason.
The certificate of admission can be printed only during the announcement and registration periods and will not be reissued.
Degree (graduation) certificates must be submitted as original documents.
Master's and integrated master's-doctoral program admits must submit a bachelor's degree (graduation) certificate; doctoral program admits must submit a master's degree (graduation) certificate.

Only applicants admitted after a video interview must submit a certificate of entry and exit, a medical certificate or similar document, as requested by their program in connection with the video interview.
Graduates of foreign universities must submit an apostille together with their degree (graduation) certificate.
Graduates from countries that have not joined the Apostille Convention must submit a confirmation from the foreign educational institution or a consular confirmation instead.

Graduates of universities in China must submit consular confirmation or an apostille of both the graduation certificate and the degree certificate, together with the CHSI Online Verification Report of Student Record (see www.chsi.com.cn).
Documents not written in Korean or English must be accompanied by a notarized Korean or English translation.
Applicants to the College of Natural Sciences and the College of Engineering must submit documents to their department (school) office, not the college academic administration office.
steps: Read the attached file (2027학년도 대학원 전기모집 합격자 안내사항.hwp); its content was not read for this translation and may contain further details.

During the registration period, print the tuition invoice (등록금고지서) from the admission results screen: admission website (admission.snu.ac.kr) > Graduate School (대학원) > General Graduate School (일반대학원) > Notices (공지사항) board. The tuition amount is shown on the invoice.

Pay tuition between 1 February 2027, 10:00, and 5 February 2027, 16:00, by virtual account transfer or credit card; payment can be made at any branch of NongHyup Bank, Woori Bank or Shinhan Bank nationwide.
Print the certificate of admission (합격증) from the same admission results screen during the announcement or registration period, as it will not be reissued.

Prepare the original degree (graduation) certificate: bachelor's for master's and integrated master's-doctoral admits, master's for doctoral admits; if you graduated from a foreign university, add the apostille, consular confirmation or institutional confirmation, CHSI report (China) and notarized translations as required.
If you were admitted after a video interview, prepare the certificate of entry and exit, medical certificate or other document requested by your program.

Submit all documents by 11 February 2027 to the academic administration office (교무행정실) of the college or graduate school to which your program belongs; if your program is in the College of Natural Sciences or the College of Engineering, submit them to your department (school) office.
translation:
[Graduate School] Information for Admitted Applicants, 2027 Academic Year Graduate School First-Round (Spring) Admission

1. Registration of admitted applicants (tuition payment)
A. Registration period: Monday 1 February 2027, 10:00 to Friday 5 February 2027, 16:00
B. Banks for payment: NongHyup Bank, Woori Bank and Shinhan Bank, nationwide
C. Payment methods: virtual account transfer, credit card payment
D. Tuition amount: shown on the tuition invoice
E. Tuition invoice (등록금고지서): can be printed from the admission results screen during the registration period ⇒ admission website (admission.snu.ac.kr) - Graduate School (대학원) - General Graduate School (일반대학원) - Notices (공지사항) board

2. Certificate of admission (합격증)
Can be printed from the admission results screen ⇒ admission website (admission.snu.ac.kr) - Graduate School (대학원) - General Graduate School (일반대학원) - Notices (공지사항) board
※ The certificate of admission can be printed only during the announcement and registration periods and will not be reissued.

Document submission: by Thursday 11 February 2027 / to the academic administration office (교무행정실) of the college (graduate school) to which the program belongs
※ Applicants to the College of Natural Sciences and the College of Engineering should submit to the office of the program (department/school) they applied to.

Required documents | Remarks
- Bachelor's degree (graduation) certificate, 1 copy (master's and integrated master's-doctoral program admits); master's degree (graduation) certificate, 1 copy (doctoral program admits) | Submit original documents. Graduates of foreign universities: see below.
- Certificate of entry and exit (출입국사실증명서), medical certificate or similar, 1 copy | Only for applicants admitted after taking a video interview. Documents requested by the program in connection with the video interview.

※ Degree (graduation) certificates of graduates of foreign universities: submit together with an apostille.
- Countries that have not joined the Apostille Convention: submit together with a confirmation from the foreign educational institution (국외교육기관확인서) or consular confirmation.
- Universities located in China: graduates of Chinese universities must submit consular confirmation or an apostille of the graduation certificate and degree certificate, together with the Online Verification Report of Student Record from the China Ministry of Education's degree certification center (CHSI) (see www.chsi.com.cn).
- Documents not written in Korean or English must be accompanied by a notarized Korean or English translation.

※ If documents are not submitted by the deadline without a special reason, admission will be cancelled.
